ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS
 PL_ID PARAMLIST; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(12); 
 ADD_WHERE VARCHAR2(10000);
 ADD_WHERE1 VARCHAR2(10000);
BEGIN

 SELECT 

 COUNT(IMP.IMPR_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM JOURNAL.IMPORTERS_JN IMP
 WHERE
 ( (:REPORT=0 AND IMP.JN_OPERATION<> 'INS')OR(:REPORT=1 AND IMP.JN_OPERATION= 'INS') ) AND 
(--1
 ( --4 
 (--5
 IMP.SUPP_LETR_NO =:LETTER_NBR 
 AND 
 (TO_CHAR(IMP.SUPP_LETR_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')=TO_CHAR(:LETTER_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') OR :LETTER_DT IS NULL )
 AND
 (SUPP_SRCE_CD=:SUP_PORT_CD OR :SUP_PORT_CD IS NULL)
 AND 
 (:LETTER_NBR IS NOT NULL)
 )--5
 
 OR
 (--6
 :LETTER_NBR IS NULL AND :START_DT IS NOT NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 ((SUPP_LETR_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT)OR(:START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL AND :LETTER_NBR IS NOT NULL) )
 )--6
 )--4
)--1
 ;
------------------------------------
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 PL_ID := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN 
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST( PL_ID ); 
 END IF; 
 PL_ID := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('tmpdata'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 --ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'SELECT1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SELECT1);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'REPORT1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_IMPR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:IMPR_NBR1);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'LTR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:LETTER_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'LTR_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:LETTER_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'SUPP_SRCE_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SUP_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;

 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_REPORT_FILE,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,PL_ID,NULL); 
 ELSE
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 
--END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 PL_ID PARAMLIST; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(12); 
 P_ADD_WHERE VARCHAR2(10000);
BEGIN
 IF :LETTER_DT IS NOT NULL AND (:START_DT IS NOT NULL OR :END_DT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 MESSAGE('يجب إدخال تاريخ الخطاب أو الفترة وليس كليهما');
 MESSAGE('يجب إدخال تاريخ الخطاب أو الفترة وليس كليهما');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF :START_DT IS NOT NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') < TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') THEN
 MESSAGE('تاريخ النهاية يجب أن يكون أكبر من تاريخ البداية');
 MESSAGE('تاريخ النهاية يجب أن يكون أكبر من تاريخ البداية');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
--STR.DISPALERT(''||:, 'ERROR');
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
 (
 SELECT 1 FROM JOURNAL.IMPORTERS_JN IMP
--(:P_CURR_PORT_CD IS NULL OR IMP.PORT_CD = :P_CURR_PORT_CD )
WHERE
 IMP.IMPR_NBR = NVL(:IMPR_NBR1,IMP.IMPR_NBR) AND
 SUPP_SRCE_CD = NVL(:SUP_PORT_CD,SUPP_SRCE_CD) AND
 SUPP_TITLE_CD = NVL(:SUPP_TITLE_CD,SUPP_TITLE_CD) AND
 SUPP_LETR_NO = NVL(:LETTER_NBR,SUPP_LETR_NO) AND
 JN_ORACLE_USER = NVL(:USER_ID,JN_ORACLE_USER) AND
 TO_CHAR(SUPP_LETR_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') = TO_CHAR(NVL(:LETTER_DT,SUPP_LETR_DT),'RRRR-MM-MI') AND
 TO_CHAR(SUPP_LETR_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') >= TO_CHAR(NVL(:START_DT,SUPP_LETR_DT),'RRRR-MM-MI') AND

PROCEDURE check_list_val IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_IMPR';
 RET NUMBER;
 D DATE;
 BEGIN
 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة اختيار بيانات محددة ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 
 -- IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD != 99 THEN
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 -- ELSE
 -- NULL;
 -- END IF;
 
 CALL_FORM('LOV_IMPR.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :IMPR_NBR1 :=:GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR ;
 :IMPR_NAME:=:GLOBAL.IMPR_NAME; 
 
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;
